# api — component: the HTTP helpers of shared/layer.js, notice.js, http.js
# a fresh page per call; "resolves"/"rejects" is the promise the page awaits.

shape: http is an object {get, post, put, patch, del}; send is a function (method, url, body, opts); every door resolves, none throws

## the request each verb sends (answered 200 {})
http.get(url): /api/x "GET", headers {"Accept":"application/json"}, body none
http.post(url, {a:1}): /api/x "POST", headers {"Accept":"application/json","Content-Type":"application/json"}, body "{\"a\":1}"
http.post(url): /api/x "POST", headers {"Accept":"application/json","Content-Type":"application/json"}, body "{}"
http.post(url, null): /api/x "POST", headers {"Accept":"application/json"}, body none
http.put(url, {a:1}): /api/x "PUT", headers {"Accept":"application/json","Content-Type":"application/json"}, body "{\"a\":1}"
http.patch(url, {a:1}): /api/x "PATCH", headers {"Accept":"application/json","Content-Type":"application/json"}, body "{\"a\":1}"
http.del(url): /api/x "DELETE", headers {"Accept":"application/json"}, body none
send("POST", url, null): /api/x "POST", headers {"Accept":"application/json"}, body none

## http.get (the door that does not throw): every answer
200 JSON object: resolves {"ok":true,"status":200,"body":{"id":7,"name":"PRESS-1"},"error":"","fieldErrors":{}}, no toast
200 JSON {"ok":false,"error":"refused"}: resolves {"ok":true,"status":200,"body":{"error":"refused","ok":false},"error":"","fieldErrors":{}}, no toast
200 empty body: resolves {"ok":true,"status":200,"body":null,"error":"","fieldErrors":{}}, no toast
204 no content: resolves {"ok":true,"status":204,"body":null,"error":"","fieldErrors":{}}, no toast
200 not JSON ("ok"): resolves {"ok":true,"status":200,"body":"ok\n","error":"","fieldErrors":{}}, no toast
400 Edge writeError / Core jsonError {"error"}: resolves {"ok":false,"status":400,"body":{"error":"process not found"},"error":"process not found","fieldErrors":{}}, toasts 1
400 Edge writeAdvisoryRefusal {"error","notice"}: resolves {"ok":false,"status":400,"body":{"error":"changeover already running","notice":true},"error":"changeover already running","fieldErrors":{}}, toasts 1
409 Edge writeErrorWithExit {"error","exit"}: resolves {"ok":false,"status":409,"body":{"error":"lane held","exit":{"kind":"release","url":"/api/x/release","label":"Release"}},"error":"lane held","fieldErrors":{}}, toasts 1
400 Core configRefusal {"error","errors","ok"}: resolves {"ok":false,"status":400,"body":{"error":"Port must be a number.","errors":{"port":"Port must be a number."},"ok":false},"error":"Port must be a number.","fieldErrors":{"port":"Port must be a number."}}, toasts 1
409 Core kanbanHeld {"drain","error","needs_force"}: resolves {"ok":false,"status":409,"body":{"drain":[],"error":"position holds bins","needs_force":true},"error":"position holds bins","fieldErrors":{}}, toasts 1
400 JSON {"error":""}: resolves {"ok":false,"status":400,"body":{"error":""},"error":"Refused (400)","fieldErrors":{}}, toasts 1
400 JSON with no error key: resolves {"ok":false,"status":400,"body":{"needs_force":true},"error":"Refused (400)","fieldErrors":{}}, toasts 1
400 JSON whose error is an object: resolves {"ok":false,"status":400,"body":{"error":{"code":7}},"error":"Refused (400)","fieldErrors":{}}, toasts 1
400 JSON null: resolves {"ok":false,"status":400,"body":null,"error":"Refused (400)","fieldErrors":{}}, toasts 1
400 plain text (http.Error): resolves {"ok":false,"status":400,"body":null,"error":"invalid bin type","fieldErrors":{}}, toasts 1
400 empty body: resolves {"ok":false,"status":400,"body":null,"error":"Refused (400)","fieldErrors":{}}, toasts 1
500 JSON {"error"}: resolves {"ok":false,"status":500,"body":{"error":"database not answering"},"error":"database not answering","fieldErrors":{}}, toasts 1
502 HTML from a proxy: resolves {"ok":false,"status":502,"body":null,"error":"Server error (502)","fieldErrors":{}}, toasts 1
no answer (fetch rejects TypeError "Failed to fetch"): resolves {"ok":false,"status":0,"body":null,"error":"No answer from the server","fieldErrors":{}}, toasts 1
